review_method: Direct inspection of all six final PNGs and the final 1440x900 production-gallery screenshot.
observations: Neutral wall reveals remain visible under reduced asset-local gallery lighting.
The mirror has a soft reflective gradient; the metal trim has broader highlights.
The default near-front view shows the mirror and both columns of unlabelled buttons.
Independent raycasts confirm all eight button centres and six of nine rear-mirror sample points are unobstructed.
The floor-fit close-up shows the sill meeting an adjacent studio mall floor at Y=0.
Hero, front, side, three-quarter and interior views retain clean compact-car proportions and no readable text or logos.
limitations: The gallery auto-fit has no asset-local zoom parameter. Final projected car size is approximately 267x385 pixels in a 1058x495 canvas. Mirror shading is metallic PBR, without live planar reflection. Adjacent-floor evidence is a local fixture check, not full-mall assembly.
